units.zh: 习近平在听取海南自由贸易港建设工作汇报时强调 认真学习贯彻党的二十届四中全会精神 高标准建设海南自由贸易港 蔡奇出席汇报会
units.en: Xi stresses building Hainan Free Trade Port with high standards

units.zh: 新华社三亚11月6日电 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平在听取海南自由贸易港建设工作汇报时强调，建设海南自由贸易港，是党中央着眼新时代全面深化改革开放作出的重大决策。要认真学习贯彻党的二十届四中全会精神，在党中央集中统一领导下，各级各有关方面密切协作、主动作为，通过持续努力，全面实现海南自由贸易港建设目标。
units.en: SANYA, Nov. 8 (Xinhua) -- President Xi Jinping, who is also general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, stressed, when hearing a work report on the building of Hainan Free Trade Port (FTP), that building the Hainan FTP is a major policy made by the CPC Central Committee to comprehensively deepen reform and opening up in the new era. He stressed the need to study and implement the guiding principles of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee. Under the centralized and unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee, all relevant parties at all levels should closely coordinate and take the initiative to fully achieve the goals of building the Hainan FTP through continuous efforts.

units.zh: 11月6日上午，习近平在海南省三亚市听取海南自由贸易港建设工作汇报。国家发展改革委主任郑栅洁、海南省委书记冯飞作了汇报。
units.en: On the morning of Nov. 6, Xi listened to the work report on the development of the Hainan FTP in Sanya, Hainan Province. Zheng Shanjie, director of the National Development and Reform Commission, and Feng Fei, secretary of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee, presented the report.

units.zh: 听取汇报后，习近平发表重要讲话。他指出，党中央决定，今年12月18日海南自由贸易港正式启动全岛封关，这是我国坚定不移扩大高水平对外开放、推动建设开放型世界经济的标志性举措。各级各有关方面要精心准备，确保平稳有序。
units.en: After listening to the report, Xi delivered an important speech. He pointed out that, following the decision of the CPC Central Committee, the Hainan FTP will officially commence its island-wide special customs operations on Dec. 18 this year. He described this as a landmark move of the country to unwaveringly expand high-standard opening up and promote the development of an open world economy. All relevant departments at all levels must make meticulous preparations to ensure a smooth and orderly transition, Xi said.

units.zh: 习近平强调，建设海南自由贸易港的战略目标，就是要把海南自由贸易港打造成为引领我国新时代对外开放的重要门户。要锚定这个战略目标不动摇，全面落实海南自由贸易港建设总体方案，深入实施海南自由贸易港法，解放思想、改革创新，分步骤、分阶段构建与高水平自由贸易港相适应的政策制度体系。要稳步扩大制度型开放，进一步提高贸易投资自由化便利化水平。深入推进商品和要素流动型开放，更好促进生产要素跨境流动。构建更加开放的人才机制，为自由贸易港建设提供有力人才支撑。深化行政体制改革，优化政务服务，着力打造市场化法治化国际化一流营商环境。
units.en: Xi stressed that the strategic goal of building the Hainan FTP is to develop it into a key gateway driving China's opening up in the new era. It is imperative to steadfastly pursue this strategic goal, fully carry out the master plan for the building of the Hainan FTP, thoroughly enforce the Hainan Free Trade Port Law, emancipate the mind, pursue reform and innovation, and build a framework of policies and institutions that aligns with a high-level FTP in a phased and step-by-step manner. Efforts should be made to steadily expand institutional opening up, and take further steps to facilitate trade and investment liberalization. The province was urged to make further progress in opening up in terms of the flows of goods and production factors, and better facilitate cross-border flows of production factors. Xi called on the province to create a more open talent mechanism to provide solid backing with a high-caliber talent pool for building the FTP. Work should be done to deepen the reform of administrative systems, improve government services, and strive to create a first-rate business environment that is market-oriented, law-based and internationalized.

units.zh: 习近平指出，高标准建设海南自由贸易港，主要目的是促进海南高质量发展，助力全国构建新发展格局。要结合实际科学编制“十五五”规划，紧紧围绕建设“三区一中心”的战略定位，全面提高海南经济社会发展水平。着力打造具有海南特色和优势的现代化产业体系，推动主导产业优化升级，促进科技创新和产业创新深度融合，努力在发展新质生产力上取得新突破。加强同粤港澳大湾区联动发展，深化同京津冀、长三角、长江经济带等区域合作，深度融入共建“一带一路”，在推进高水平对外开放中发挥牵引作用。生态是海南一大优势，要守护好这份家底，坚持陆海统筹，持续抓好突出环境问题整治，高质量建设国家生态文明试验区。加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设，解决好人民群众急难愁盼问题，扎实推进共同富裕。
units.en: Xi pointed out that building the Hainan FTP with high standards is meant to promote high-quality development in Hainan and boost national efforts to create a new development paradigm. He called on Hainan to scientifically formulate its 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) based on practical conditions, and focus closely on its strategic positioning as a pilot zone for the comprehensive deepening of reform and opening up, a national pilot zone for ecological conservation, an international tourism and consumption destination, and a service zone for major national strategies, thereby comprehensively boosting the province's economic and social development. Efforts should be made to develop a modernized industrial system that leverages Hainan's characteristics and strengths, promote the upgrading of leading industries, and advance the deep integration of technological and industrial innovation to achieve breakthroughs in developing new quality productive forces. It is essential for the island province to strengthen coordinated development with the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, deepen cooperation with the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta and the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and deeply integrate into the Belt and Road cooperation to play a leading role in advancing high-standard opening up. As ecology is a great advantage for Hainan, it is imperative to safeguard such a "family legacy," adhere to coordination between land and sea, make continuous efforts to address prominent environmental issues, and advance the high-quality development of the national pilot zone for ecological conservation. It is essential to provide inclusive services, meet essential needs and provide a cushion for those most in need while improving people's well-being, resolve the pressing difficulties and problems that concern the people the most, and make solid progress toward common prosperity.

units.zh: 习近平强调，越是扩大开放，越要统筹发展和安全，牢牢守住安全底线。要科学有序安排开放节奏和进度，加强风险识别和防范，稳扎稳打、步步为营。
units.en: Xi stressed that the wider the door is opened, the more imperative it is to pursue development while ensuring security and firmly safeguard the red line for security. It is imperative to proceed the opening up in a sound and orderly manner, identify and prevent risks, and advance with steady and solid steps.

units.zh: 习近平指出，要以永远在路上的清醒和坚定推进全面从严治党，巩固深入贯彻中央八项规定精神学习教育成果，努力营造风清气正的政治生态。完善一体推进不敢腐、不能腐、不想腐工作机制，着力铲除腐败滋生的土壤和条件。要引导各级干部在遵规守纪前提下敢于担当、善于作为，用扎实奋斗创造经得起实践和历史检验的工作业绩。
units.en: Xi emphasized the imperative to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance with enduring vigilance and determination, consolidate the achievements made during the education campaign on thoroughly implementing the CPC Central Committee's eight-point decision on improving work conduct, and foster a healthy political environment of integrity. He also emphasized that efforts must be made to improve the integrated mechanism to ensure that officials do not have the audacity, opportunity, or desire to become corrupt, and eradicate the breeding grounds and conditions for corruption. He urged the province to guide officials at all levels to have a stronger sense of responsibility and perform their duties well while strictly abiding by rules and regulations, and accomplish achievements that stand the test of time.

units.zh: 习近平强调，当前海南要紧盯“海鸥”台风走势，完善有关措施，切实做好防范和应急处置工作，确保把损失降到最低。
units.en: Xi also urged Hainan to closely monitor Typhoon Kalmaegi and take concrete measures for prevention and emergency response to minimize losses.

units.zh: 中共中央政治局常委、中央办公厅主任蔡奇出席汇报会。
units.en: Cai Qi, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, attended the meeting.

units.zh: 何立峰及中央和国家机关有关部门、海南省负责同志参加汇报会。（完）
units.en: He Lifeng and leading officials from relevant central Party and state departments, and the Hainan CPC provincial committee and government also attended the meeting.  Enditem
